name: Polygaloides paucifolia
desc: Polygaloides paucifolia (Polygaloides paucifolia): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 18 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Chamaebuxus paucifolia, synonyms including Polygaloides paucifolia and Polygala paucifolia, known as gaywings or fringed polygala, is a perennial plant of the family Polygalaceae.
